metadata.name: 元
metadata.description: cell A1 of the origin spreadsheet. holds a formula/value that executes and renders in place; seeded with the readme. un-deletable (clearing restores the readme); editable.

cels.f:
(mount "top"
  (dom "div.readme" (style "max-width" "46rem" "margin" "0 auto" "padding" "1.1rem 1.3rem" "border" "1px solid #8884" "border-radius" ".7rem" "background" "#8881" "font" "13px/1.55 ui-monospace, monospace")
    (dom "h1" (style "margin" "0 0 .2rem" "font-size" "1.7rem" "font-family" "system-ui") "plastron 🐢")
    (dom "p" (style "margin" "0 0 .8rem" "color" "#888" "font-family" "system-ui") "a spreadsheet where formulas can also build dom, cels, sheets, and apps. every formula starts with = — try these:")
    (dom "pre" (style "margin" ".12rem 0") "=1 + 1")
    (dom "pre" (style "margin" ".12rem 0") "=grid(8, 5)              a worksheet of editable cels")
    (dom "pre" (style "margin" ".12rem 0") "=grid(\"in\", 4, 3, \"out\", 4, 3)   a workbook of named sheets")
    (dom "pre" (style "margin" ".12rem 0") "=def(\"double\", \"js\", \"x => x * 2\")   a function from javascript")
    (dom "pre" (style "margin" ".12rem 0") "=double(21)                call your function -> 42")
    (dom "pre" (style "margin" ".12rem 0" "color" "tomato") "=dom(\"h2\", style(\"color\", \"tomato\"), \"styled\")")
    (dom "pre" (style "margin" ".12rem 0") "=mount(\".sheet\", dom(\"p\", \"under the cells\"))  pin dom under an element")
    (dom "pre" (style "margin" ".12rem 0") "=inspect(\"mount\")           a function: signature + source")
    (dom "pre" (style "margin" ".12rem 0") "=segments()                loaded libraries")
    (dom "pre" (style "margin" ".12rem 0") "=vocab(\"origin\")            what you can call")
    (dom "pre" (style "margin" ".12rem 0") "=checkpoint(\"safe\")          a snapshot to restore")
    (dom "pre" (style "margin" ".12rem 0") "=load(\"sheet\")              load a library")
    (dom "p" (style "margin" ".7rem 0 0" "font-size" ".82rem" "font-family" "system-ui") "this whole page is one index.html — no install, no PWA. the ↓ save button keeps a copy with your sheet baked in; double-click it to run offline from your desktop.")
    (dom "p" (style "margin" ".4rem 0 0" "color" "#888" "font-size" ".82rem" "font-family" "system-ui") "click 元 to edit this; clear it to bring it back.")))

metadata.name: 元.mount
metadata.description: where the sheet view mounts. the host's one knob; null hides it.

metadata.name: 元.editing
metadata.description: key of the cell currently being edited (null = none).

metadata.name: 元.draft
metadata.description: the edit input's in-progress text.

metadata.name: 元.error
metadata.description: compile/parse error for the cell being edited (null = none); shown under the active editor so a bad formula doesn't fail silently.

metadata.name: 元.cells
metadata.description: ordered spreadsheet cell keys: 元 (A1) + genesis-created grid cels.

metadata.name: 元.view
metadata.description: the spreadsheet view. UNLOCKED — renders each cel as an editable cell; rework in place.

cels.f: (originView editing draft mount error keys vals)

metadata.name: originView
metadata.description: (editing expanded draft mount keys vals) - spreadsheet RenderSpec producer: 元 button + grid() layers as Excel tables + expanded formula panel.

metadata.name: dom
metadata.description: (tag ...children) - a presentation vnode value. tag.class emmet sugar; string children -> text, nested dom -> elements. Renders in the cell that holds it.

metadata.name: style
metadata.description: (prop value ...) - inline styles for a dom element; pass as a child of dom.

metadata.name: mount
metadata.description: (target content) - pin a dom under another element of the sheet instead of in the cell that holds it. target is a selector matched against the view: ".sheet" pins under the cells, "div.cell" under the first cell, "#id" by id; a bare word ("top"/"bottom") is a region anchor laid out around the sheet. Deleting the formula removes it.

metadata.name: grid
metadata.description: genesis: worksheets of editable cels, each like 元. grid(rows, cols) makes one sheet (auto-named g<r>x<c> so shapes don't collide); grid(rows, cols, "name") names it; grid("in", 4, 3, "out", 4, 3) — a string first arg — makes a WORKBOOK of named sheets. delete the formula -> swept.

metadata.name: origin.commit
metadata.description: (state, cellKey) - set the cell's content from the draft and re-evaluate; rebuild the cell list (new grids in, swept out); 元 un-deletable (empty restores readme).

metadata.name: origin.edit
metadata.description: (state, cellKey) - start editing a cell (seed draft with its source); click the active cell's label again to close.

metadata.name: origin.key
metadata.description: (state, cellKey, event) - Enter commits the draft.

metadata.name: origin.effects
metadata.description: load/cels requests commit here (effects at drain).

metadata.name: origin.drain
metadata.description: (items) - execute load (ensureSegments) and cels (segment listing) requests; result text replaces the request as the cel's value.

metadata.name: load
metadata.description: (name) - load a library segment (lazy loaders + store).

metadata.name: cels
metadata.description: (segment) - readable listing of a segment's cels (skill first; locked marked).

metadata.name: inspect
metadata.description: (key) - the cel's full definition (celType, value, formula, metadata) as readable JSON.

metadata.name: segments
metadata.description: () - every loaded segment with role, version, dependencies.

metadata.name: vocab
metadata.description: (segment?) - the values + functions usable in formulas (callable lambdas/compilers + value cels) with descriptions; no arg = across all loaded segments.

metadata.name: def
metadata.description: (name, kind, source) - define a callable function from source in a compiler kind ("js" works out of the box). =def("double", "js", "x => x * 2") then call it: =double(21) -> 42.
